policy.carriers: An inert vehicle the supplement is given in (a sugar, starch, cellulose, water, juice, flavouring, capsule) is not a co-intervention WHEN every administered ingredient arm of the trial gets it: it is the preparation, and a placebo is by design that vehicle. When one ingredient arm gets it and another does not (creatine vs creatine + glucose), the trial varies it and it IS a co-intervention. An entry matches only as a bare name ("glucose"), never with a dose or other words. Measured on run 20261028_082425: 3 matched trials (dextrose, maltodextrin) were refused as 'arms differ', 2 designed creatine + glucose arms stay refused.
